title: Clinical Study on the Effect of Elevit Pregnancy 2nd & 3rd Trimester (Multi-micronutrients & DHA Supplement) on the Nutritional Status of Pregnant Women During Second and Third Trimester

sections.abstract: The aim of this study is to collect information how adding a soft gel preparation of micronutrients such as vitamins, dietary minerals plus omega-3 fatty acid (docosahexaenoic acid, DHA) to the diet of pregnant women during the 2nd and 3rd trimesters of pregnancy effects the nutritional state of the mother and infants at delivery.
